text:
elaine: kicking off AuroraEdge RFI thread — they want a pilot for embeddings + semantic ranking, must show private/VPC deployment with BYO-HSM, SAML SSO, SCIM, and 99th-pctl latency targets. deadline next Friday. who owns the capability matrix + security answers?

matt: I can take the matrix. need peak embed QPS and typical context sizes. any spreadsheet?

elaine: uploaded RFI to drive: https://drive.redwood/auroraedge/rfi_2026.pdf. they list 110 peak embed qps, 35 sustained, avg token 9, long contexts up to 1500 tokens.

zara: 110 qps — Hosted w/ caching + batching will handle it; Private for latency-critical path likely needs 2x L4 or 1x H100. For pilot propose Hosted dedicated pool then validate Private.

matt: pricing ask: monthly estimate for Hosted managed, Dedicated reserved, and one-time Private infra + monthly support. rough numbers OK for RFI.

zara: quick ballpark: Hosted (cached): ~$13k/mo. Dedicated (2x L4 baseline): ~$34k/mo. Private deployment one-time ~$85k + $7k/mo support. label as estimates.

elaine: HSM question: customer expects FIPS 140-2 HSM and BYOK within 10 business days. realistic?

zara: typical HSM procurement + validation is 3+ weeks. add RFI note: "HSM: BYO-HSM supported for Private; provisioning and validation typically 3+ weeks; accelerated procurement may be possible but requires vendor & logistics alignment."

matt: security Q about payload retention — need exact wording.

zara: suggested phrasing: `Hosted: request metadata retained 30 days; payloads are redacted by default unless customer opts in. Private: full customer control over retention and logging.`

elaine: they also asked about graceful degradation if Dedicated saturates and whether we can route to a quantized variant.

matt: add: "Graceful degradation: automated routing to compatible quantized model in same region with configurable priority rules. Fallback latency and quality impacts documented in matrix."

devops-bot: uploaded capability matrix draft: https://files.redwood/cap-matrix/auroraedge_matrix_v1.csv :white_check_mark:

matt: two small asks for the matrix: (1) include 99th-pctl latency rows for embeddings at 9 tokens and 1500 tokens, (2) confirm Private supports outbound webhook callbacks for tool integrations.

zara: latency estimates to use: `Embeddings (9t): 99th pctl 52ms (Hosted cached), 120ms (Private baseline)` and `Embeddings (1500t): 99th pctl 360ms (Hosted cached), 820ms (Private baseline)`. Private supports webhook callbacks via local agents bridge — customers must whitelist targets. doc: https://docs.redwood/private-tooling

elaine: legal/export controls need verifying before sending. pinging @legal for final line.

legal: suggested export control wording: `Standard U.S. export control laws apply. For restricted jurisdictions or specific export-control regimes, we recommend Private deployment and legal review.`

matt: please add a short curl smoke-test for their engineers to validate embeddings during the pilot.

zara: adding snippet to matrix notes:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \ 
  -H "Idempotency-Key: aurora-smoke-01" \ 
  -d '{"model":"r-instruct-emb-1","input":"test case"}'
```

elaine: thanks — I'll assemble the RFI bundle with matrix, security answers PDF, HSM caveat, ops runbook (VPC peering checklist, KMS steps), and the smoke-test. planning to send Thu AM. flag any blockers now. :rocket:
